title: Divergent impacts of antibiotics on ferrihydrite biotransformation by Shewanella oneidensis: electron transfer regulation and iron redox cycling
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,2412-2427
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01195G, Paper
Xinyue Li, Jianxin Chen, Xiyuan Chen, Yuxin Wang, Jieyu Li, Xiangchun Guo, Yan Shi, Kejing Zhang, Zhang Lin
Antibiotics mediate/compete for electrons, coupling degradation with Fe redox and controlling mineral pathways. SMX promotes electron flux and the conversion of Fh to magnetite; CAP, however, competes for electrons and traps Fh as goethite.
